name: midi-file-viewer
description: Open a Standard MIDI File and see all of it: MidiFileViewer(bytes) reads the file, names each part by its General MIDI instrument (kit pieces on channel 10), and lays out a multi-part piano roll with a drum grid, tempo, sustain-pedal, velocity and controller lanes on one shared zoom/pan viewport, a parts panel (instrument, colour, note count, show/hide), a one-line header summary (duration, bars, meter, key, tempo range, parts, notes, pedal presses), and a bars/beats vs seconds axis toggle that follows tempo changes and defaults to seconds when the tempo varies. No playback.
